body:
OBSERVED 2026-08-07 on PR #1424 (@siuwai1999, translate-zh-tw, safe-tier-1 +
community-reviewed).

`gh pr checks 1424` returns only:

    validate-author  pass
    evaluate         skipping
    guard            skipping

There is no FAILURE row, so the PR reads as "nothing red" to a human or an agent
scanning the rollup. In fact the `Test Suite` workflow **never ran**: its run for
the 17:48Z head sha sits in `completed/action_required` (the first-time-outside-
contributor approval gate), and after the contributor pushed again at 20:50Z no
Test Suite run was created for the new sha at all.

So for this PR the merge gate's condition (a) -- "every required CI check is
green on the PR's current head" -- is not merely unmet, it is unevaluable, and
the absence of a red check is what makes that invisible. This is the same shape
as the already-recorded lesson that `gh` reports an in-progress check as done
when you read `.conclusion` instead of `.status`: absence is being read as
success.

Why it matters here specifically: this is a `.po`-only translation PR, and the
suite that never ran includes `tests/unit/test_translations_compile.py`, the
msgfmt gate added precisely because v4.0.47 shipped a Hungarian locale that
silently failed to compile and fell back to English for a whole release cycle.
A malformed .po is exactly what this PR could carry and exactly what did not get
checked.

Not an auto-merge risk: `.github/workflows/auto-merge.yml:54` bails on fork PRs
(`head.repo.full_name == github.repository`), so nothing merges this
automatically. The exposure is a human or autopilot tick merging it manually
after reading the rollup as clean.

Suggested fix: the merge gate should require the named required checks to be
PRESENT and SUCCESS, not merely "no failures" -- i.e. assert the expected check
names appear in statusCheckRollup. A cheap first step is a preflight that flags
any open PR whose `Test Suite Summary` check is absent.

Mitigation applied this tick: approved the pending run via
`POST /actions/runs/31124176569/approve` so the suite executes before any merge
decision on #1424. #1424 was NOT merged.
title: Fork PR with CI stuck in action_required reads as green to the merge gate
